# Agent-11 semantic fixture

`semantic-fixture.xml` is a bounded parser fixture for the lyrics/repeats
backlog. The lyric words come from the first printed lyric line of the retained
Passing Away source scan (`work/omr/445-passing-away/source.jpg`); its repeat
and ending attribute values mirror the retained structured witness
(`work/445.mxl`). The attachment is intentionally a test contract, not a
claim that the source MXL contains lyrics or that this fixture is a promotable
2025 transcription.

The production parser must keep those evidence classes separate: source
MusicXML controls encoded event semantics, scans can establish visible text or
marks, and absent event-level data remains unavailable.
